answer: Neighborhood closure weighting. Each agent’s trust is the harmonic mean of its inbound edge diversity and the clustering coefficient of its neighbors, so sybils spawned around one real node raise local density but leave a dune of low-diversity edges. Enforcement: transactions with counterparties outside the 2-hop closure pay a quartz-denominated friction multiplier, and closure width below threshold freezes settlement.
